claude.sample_unit: cornea trainees (each reviewing 39 real-world corneal cases under three conditions)

links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic accuracy with RAG-grounded specialized LLM versus general GPT-4o and unaided
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy unaided 48.7%, 20.5%, 38.5%; general GPT-4o 69.2%, 46.2%, 59.0%; RAG-specialized 71.8%, 48.7%, 74.4%, improved over unaided for all clinicians (p<0.01).
links.quote: The cornea-specialized GPT-4o further improved accuracy to 71.8%, 48.7%, and 74.4%, with improvements over unaided performance for all clinicians (p<0.01).

links.outcome: Clinician management accuracy with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Management accuracy inconsistent: Ophthalmologist 3 improved to 71.8% (p<0.05), Ophthalmologist 1 remained 82.1%, Ophthalmologist 2 declined to 64.1% (p<0.05) from 87.2%.
links.quote: With the specialized model, Ophthalmologist 3 improved to 71.8% (p<0.05), Ophthalmologist 1 remained high at 82.1%, and Ophthalmologist 2 declined to 64.1% (p<0.05).

links.effect: Diagnosis improved with AI; specialized diagnostic accuracy 71.8%, 48.7%, 74.4% (p<0.01), while management improved for one clinician and declined for one.
links.quote: Effects on management accuracy were inconsistent.

links.outcome: specialized model versus unaided and GPT-4o
links.effect: General GPT-4o diagnostic accuracy was 69.2%, 46.2%, 59.0%; specialized GPT-4o was 71.8%, 48.7%, 74.4%; management effects were inconsistent.
links.quote: The cornea-specialized GPT-4o further improved accuracy to 71.8%, 48.7%, and 74.4%, with improvements over unaided performance for all clinicians (p<0.01).

links.outcome: RAG-specialized LLM diagnostic and management accuracy
links.effect: RAG-specialized diagnostic accuracy improved to 71.8%, 48.7%, 74.4% (p<0.01); next-step management was 82.1%, 64.1%, 71.8% with mixed effects.
links.quote: A cornea-specialized LLM enhanced with RAG improved diagnostic accuracy in complex corneal cases, particularly among clinicians with lower baseline performance.

links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy was 48.7%, 20.5%, and 38.5% unaided, 69.2%, 46.2%, and 59.0% with general GPT-4o, and improved to 71.8%, 48.7%, and 74.4% with specialized GPT-4o (p<0.01 vs unaided).
links.quote: The cornea-specialized GPT-4o further improved accuracy to 71.8%, 48.7%, and 74.4%, with improvements over unaided performance for all clinicians (p<0.01).

links.effect: Unaided accuracy was 76.9%, 87.2%, and 59.0%; with specialized model, Ophthalmologist 3 improved to 71.8% (p<0.05), Ophthalmologist 1 was 82.1%, and Ophthalmologist 2 declined to 64.1% (p<0.05).
links.quote: With the specialized model, Ophthalmologist 3 improved to 71.8% (p<0.05), Ophthalmologist 1 remained high at 82.1%, and Ophthalmologist 2 declined to 64.1% (p<0.05).
